messages:
elaine (Finance): FYI Helios reported a ~20% platform fee increase after moving some workloads -> auto-node. They claim contract ties fees to committed GPU-hours. Can we triage?

omar (AE): Priya sent invoice + note. She says platform fee line doubled after migration.

sasha (Solutions): We saw metric_key flip to node_compute_hours for their account after the change. ETL billed node hours by default.

billing-bot: Invoice 993010 for HLS-321 posted. Platform fee = $16,400.

elaine (Finance): Need delta estimate so we can propose provisional credit (< $15k auto-approve).

sasha (Solutions): Quick calc: node-based platform fee $16,400 vs committed-gpu-based $6,900 -> delta $9,500.

ematt (CustSuccess): Customer asks for a prompt response.

elaine (Finance): Opening provisional credit for $9,500. Tag as reversible pending audit.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2024-330 issued for $9,500 (PROVISIONAL) against Invoice 993010.

omar (AE): I'll notify Priya and ask for their infra logs.

sasha (Solutions): I'll file PR to apply node->gpu conversion for accounts with active commits and add a metric-key-change alert.

elaine (Finance): OK. Keep this thread updated and attach invoice PDF to the credit request.
